item.title: Protests held across Tampa Bay over Minneapolis ICE-involved shooting
item.description: Over 100 Tampa Bay area residents rallied outside of Tampa City Council Thursday afternoon for a protest surrounding recent events in Minnesota. Another smaller group hosted a similar event in Sarasota.
